## Tooltip.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `content` :: The hint. A string, or a snippet for richer content.
- `surface` :: The surface behind the hint. Defaults to `glass`.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the hint.
- `placement` :: Where the hint sits relative to the trigger.
- `delay` :: How long to wait, in milliseconds, before opening on hover or focus. Adjacent tooltips skip this while the group is warm.
- `closeDelay` :: How long to wait, in milliseconds, before closing after hover or focus leaves.
- `trigger` :: The element the hint describes. Spread `props` onto your own control.

## tooltip.ts

### `const enterFrom`

Enter class so the hint originates from the trigger side.

### `const WARM_WINDOW`

Window after a tooltip closes during which the next one opens instantly.

### `function openDelay`

The delay to use for this open, or `0` when the group is still warm.

### `function markWarm`

Mark the shared group as warm, so a neighbouring tooltip opens instantly.

### `function hintPopover`

Prefer `popover="hint"` (does not trap pointer or focus). Fall back to `manual` when the engine does not implement hint.
